'''Rigo Devane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Personality and traits==
Devane was interested in technology and he also got on well with most people. He was quiet and would fade into the background when not needed.

==Behind the scenes==
Devane makes a possible appearance in ''[[Inside-out: Storm's Depths|Storm's Depths]]'', a scenario in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. In the scenario, if the player characters require technical support, then [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] sends Devane with them on a mission.
